text:
mira: Quick q — I'm bringing my Steam Deck + USB-C dock to Friday's game night. Anyone have a spare Pro Controller or Bluetooth pad I can borrow? Also, does the breakroom TV play nicely with the Deck dock's HDMI audio?

jon: I can bring my Switch Pro controller :+1: and a USB-C cable.

sam: TV should be fine. FYI the dock + cheap hubs sometimes drop to 30hz. Use a proper USB-C hub with HDMI 2.0 and PD passthrough if you want stable 60hz.

ben: For local games, wired X360/Xbox controllers are the most plug-and-play on Deck. I can bring one.

mira: Awesome, thank you! Any tips for setting up Bluetooth controllers on the Deck quickly? Don't want to waste time fiddling before people show up.

sam: Quick steps: Settings -> Bluetooth -> Turn on pairing, then hold the controller's pair button. Steam deck pairs fine that way. If it misbehaves, open Steam -> Settings -> Controller -> General Controller Settings.

jon: Also bring a small USB-A hub in case you need to plug multiple wired pads into the dock.

ben: Pro tip: launch Desktop mode, run `pavucontrol` if audio routes wrong, pick HDMI output.

mira: Noted. I only packed my 18W charger — anyone have a 65W PD brick I can borrow for the dock/charging?

jon: Yep, I'll bring a 65W PD brick and an extra USB-C cable.

sam: I'll bring an HDMI cable (longer one) and the hub I mentioned.

deploy-bot: Reminder — Game Night: Friday 18:00 in the breakroom. RSVP here: https://example.com/rsvp :game_die:

mira: Perfect. Thanks all — should be able to run some 4-player TowerFall and Stardew on the big screen. See you Friday! :party_parrot:
